active_objective: Prepare a Windows + PowerShell production deployment path without claiming readiness before security, gate, packaging, and target-workstation evidence are closed.

todos.summary: Remediate or formally accept current npm audit and packaging audit findings.
Confirm the documented Windows command path after dependency audit remediation: bootstrap, tests, e2e, gate, package, release evidence, compliance, and customer bundle.

Validate packaged activation, commissioning, live provider speech, TTS playback, autostart, upgrade, rollback, display assignment, microphone assignment, and retained evidence on the real Windows target workstation.
Either add Windows-compatible lint/format commands or formally keep TypeScript, tests, packaging audit, and gate as the checked quality surface.
Recheck README, docs/PROJECT_SPEC.md, scripts/README.md, and scripts/script.md after the full retained gate and release commands pass.

blockers: Dependency security audit and packaging audit are not confirmed clean for release.
Full retained Windows gate with packaged automation still needs to pass after security remediation or formal acceptance.

Production close-out requires real Windows target hardware, live provider credentials, activation inputs, signing inputs or approved unsigned-package exception, retained installer comparison outputs, and real logon/autostart validation.
risks: There is no checked-in lint or format command.
Electron renderer windows and setup wizard still use sandbox:false and require explicit acceptance or remediation before claiming security readiness.
Local workstation .env display and microphone assignments can drift from current hardware and must be refreshed through setup before handoff validation.
Large source and script files increase maintenance risk and should be reviewed outside the documentation/script alignment pass.
Documentation now reflects the intended Windows + PowerShell command path, but package, release bundle, and target-workstation commands remain to be reconfirmed after blockers are closed.
